app.title: KRAS PASS
app.subtitle: The Grand Mini-Game Cup
app.tagline: Eight realms. One vortex. No mercy.
game.relic_hold.name: Relic Hold
game.relic_hold.rules: Holding the relic scores every second, but you cannot swing while you carry it. Hit the carrier to make them drop it, then survive with it yourself.
game.tag_hunt.name: Tag Hunt
game.tag_hunt.desc: Your turn to chase. Or to run.
game.tag_hunt.rules: One hunter, slightly faster than everyone else. Touch someone and they become the hunter; every tag pays. Staying free scores slowly.
game.base_siege.name: Base Siege
game.base_siege.desc: Four crystals, and one you cannot break.
game.base_siege.rules: Attack rival crystals with swings or charges while guarding your own. Lose your crystal and you are out of the round.
game.drift_floes.name: Drift Floes
game.drift_floes.desc: The floor moves, and it is taking you with it.
game.drift_floes.rules: Ice plates slide under your feet and carry you toward the water. Shove the others out of the ring, and watch which floe you are standing on.
game.duo_clash.name: Duo Clash
game.duo_clash.desc: Two on two, and a scoreboard with two rows.
game.duo_clash.rules: Two sides: slots 0 and 2 against 1 and 3. A partner cannot hurt you, ring-outs pay the pair, and the round ends when a side is gone.

world.greenvale.name: Green Vale
world.greenvale.desc: Where every competitor's first cup is won.
world.tidehollow.name: Tide Hollow
world.tidehollow.desc: The water decides who stands still.
world.embersouq.name: Ember Souq
world.embersouq.desc: Trade blows in the heat of the market.
world.skyloft.name: Sky Loft
world.skyloft.desc: Nothing up here is guaranteed to hold.
world.cogworks.name: Cogworks
world.cogworks.desc: The machine at the heart of the whirl.
game.ring_rumble.name: Ring Rumble
game.ring_rumble.rules: Push the others over the edge. Pick up drops to carry a random bomb, then throw it with attack; the first blast knocks the mount away, and the next can burn, freeze or splash them out.
game.crumble_court.name: Crumble Court
game.crumble_court.desc: The floor gives way where you stand.
game.crumble_court.rules: Every tile collapses a moment after you step on it. Keep moving, and push rivals onto tiles that are already falling.
game.bumper_bowl.name: Bumper Bowl
game.bumper_bowl.desc: A bowl full of things that hit back.
game.bumper_bowl.rules: Bumpers fling anything that touches them. Score a point every time a rival is launched out of the bowl.
game.goal_guard.name: Goal Guard
game.goal_guard.rules: Each competitor defends one side. Deflect the balls away from your goal — every ball that gets past costs you a point.
game.magnet_court.name: Magnet Court
game.magnet_court.desc: Catch the storm, then throw it back.
game.magnet_court.rules: Defend your wall — and carry a one-charge magnet: for a beat it pulls nearby balls in, then hurls them all away from your goal. The charge refills slowly, so pick your moment.
game.storm_heart.name: Storm Heart
game.storm_heart.desc: The machine in the middle is not on your side.
game.storm_heart.rules: Goal Guard around a spinning turbine: every few seconds it whirls up and hurls every ball outward on a different bearing. Watch the blades — they warn you before they strike.
game.sky_court.name: Sky Court
game.sky_court.desc: Four engines, and less trust than you'd like.
game.sky_court.rules: The court hangs in the sky. When an engine dies the deck really tilts and every ball bends toward the low corner — read the slope before it reads your goal.
game.blast_ball.name: Blast Ball
game.blast_ball.rules: The ball is armed. Hit it toward someone else before the fuse runs out — the one closest to the blast is eliminated.
game.scrap_karts.name: Scrap Karts
game.scrap_karts.desc: Drive into things until only you remain.
game.scrap_karts.rules: Ram rivals at speed to damage them. Your kart takes damage too. Last kart running wins the round.
game.turret_duel.name: Turret Duel
game.turret_duel.rules: Drive and shoot. Every hit scores; every hit you take does not. Pillars block shots — use them.
game.gem_grab.name: Gem Grab
game.gem_grab.rules: Gems spawn across the islands. Hitting a rival makes them drop some of theirs. Highest count at the whistle wins.
game.star_rush.name: Star Rush
game.star_rush.desc: Carry it home or lose it.
game.star_rush.rules: Stars are only worth points once you carry them to your base. Get hit on the way and you drop everything.
game.paint_grid.name: Paint Grid
game.paint_grid.desc: Cover the floor in your colour.
game.paint_grid.rules: Every tile you cross turns your colour — including tiles a rival already claimed. Most tiles at the end wins.
game.zone_hold.name: Zone Hold
game.zone_hold.rules: A capture zone moves around the ring. Be the only one inside it to score, and shove out anyone who joins you.
game.crate_smash.name: Crate Smash
game.crate_smash.rules: Smash crates for points. The dark ones are rigged and will cost you — look before you swing.
game.crate_relay.name: Crate Relay
game.crate_relay.rules: Carry crates from the centre to your dock. You can only hold one, and a solid hit makes you drop it.
game.hurdle_dash.name: Hurdle Dash
game.hurdle_dash.desc: Straight line. Not a simple one.
game.hurdle_dash.rules: Race to the finish. Clip a hurdle and you stumble. Fastest time wins the round.
game.kart_sprint.name: Kart Sprint
game.kart_sprint.rules: Complete the laps first. Boost pads reward the racing line; the wall does not.
game.color_stand.name: Colour Stand
game.color_stand.desc: Be standing on the right one.
game.color_stand.rules: A colour is called, then the rest of the floor drops away. Get onto the called colour before it does.
game.symbol_echo.name: Symbol Echo
game.symbol_echo.desc: Watch it once. Repeat it exactly.
game.symbol_echo.rules: A sequence of pads lights up. Step on them in the same order. Each correct sequence is longer than the last.
game.quick_draw.name: Quick Draw
game.quick_draw.rules: Hit the button the instant the signal shows — but not before. A false start costs you the round's points.
game.rising_tide.name: Rising Tide
game.rising_tide.desc: Up is the only direction left.
game.rising_tide.rules: The water keeps rising. Climb the spire, take the higher platforms, and outlast everyone else.
game.sweeper_storm.name: Sweeper Storm
game.sweeper_storm.desc: The arena is trying to remove you.
game.sweeper_storm.rules: Rotating arms sweep the ring and speed up over time. Jump them, dodge them, survive them.
game.duel_pit.name: Duel Pit
game.duel_pit.rules: Damage builds up: the more a rival has taken, the further your next hit sends them. Knock them out three times.

game.fawda.name: Fawda
game.fawda.desc: The fuse is lit, and it is on nobody's side.
game.fawda.rules: Shove your rivals off the ring — while bombs drop with their fuses already burning. Walk over one to carry it, press attack to throw it. You cannot swing while carrying, and a bomb that goes off in your hands throws you further than any shove.
game.mnatiq.name: Regions
game.mnatiq.desc: Draw your border; what it holds is yours.
game.mnatiq.rules: Every tile you cross becomes yours. But close a loop around an area and the whole pocket flips to you at once — drawing beats walking.
game.mukharrib.name: The Saboteur
game.mukharrib.desc: A machine that takes nobody's side.
game.mukharrib.rules: Claim tiles while a neutral drone patrols: it marks a square in white, then scrubs it and its neighbours back to bare floor. It hunts whoever leads — so read its route and paint behind it, not ahead of it.
game.lab_crates.name: The Lab
game.lab_crates.rules: Smash crates for points and beware the rigged ones. Now with green specimen boxes: they pay no points but arm you on the spot — a shockwave, an eight-way volley, or a heavy ingot of score.
game.boss_forge.name: The Forge Warden
game.boss_forge.desc: Its shell is armoured. Its ammunition is not.
game.boss_forge.rules: Your blows do nothing to it. It lobs iron crates — smash one for glowing slag, then shove the slag into its intake before it cools. Whoever feeds it banks the damage.
game.boss_colossus.name: The Colossus
game.boss_colossus.desc: It does not want your health. It wants you off the edge.
game.boss_colossus.rules: Its slams tear craters that never repair, and its sweeps arc across the ring. After every slam the fist lies buried for a moment — that moment is the only opening you get.
game.boss_dreadnought.name: The Dreadnought
game.boss_dreadnought.desc: Armoured up front, open at the back.
game.boss_dreadnought.rules: It turns to face whoever hurt it last, so the four of you cannot all stand behind it. Three phases: shells, then mines, then a spin that leaves no safe standing spot. Strike the vents.
game.boss_sovereign.name: The Sovereign
game.boss_sovereign.desc: It does not speed up between phases. It changes the game.
game.boss_sovereign.rules: Three phases, three different fights: a pursuit that punishes standing still, a siege whose shield only falls to its own orbs sent back, then a collapse that throws everything at once. Damage is banked per player.
world.frostreach.name: Frostreach
world.frostreach.desc: Ice holds no foot and forgives no edge.
world.dunes.name: The Dunes
world.dunes.desc: Heat, a race, and sand that hides everything.
world.citadel.name: The Citadel
world.citadel.desc: One crystal each to guard, and three to break.
world.summit.name: The Summit
world.summit.desc: The last realm. Nobody arrives here by luck.
world.boss.label: Boss fight
game.sabaq_sawarikh.name: Rocket Rally
game.sabaq_sawarikh.desc: Three laps, and crates that decide them.
game.sabaq_sawarikh.rules: Finish three laps first. Drive through a crate for a weapon: a rocket that chases the kart ahead, a bomb you leave behind, a speed burst, or a shield. A hit spins you out for a moment, it never ends your race — and the further back you are, the better the crate.
